title: decK basic-auth stored hash is never translated into a usable credential
claims: even with credential inclusion enabled, a dumped basic-auth hash appears in no output, report or log
the basic-auth route never forwards an unauthenticated request
presenting the stored hash as a password is not accepted
the report raises an error requiring credential re-provisioning
not_claimed: Any working basic-auth login after migration (requires re-provisioning outside the converter)
source_semantics: Kong stores basic-auth passwords hashed; decK dumps the hash. A hash is not a password, and replaying a dump re-hashes it, so equivalence cannot be preserved from file input alone. The stored-hash probe is migration policy (ferrum_only).

probes.note: migration policy: a stored hash must never act as a password
